about: A large collection of everyday helper functions for Go.

prs.title: Snake case handles names like UserID and APIKey
prs.broken: Turning names like UserID or APIKey into snake_case left the capital letters as they were, giving userID or API_key.
prs.changed: It now splits and lower-cases acronyms, so the results are user_id and api_key.
prs.matters: Database columns, JSON fields and settings names come out the way people expect.
